analysis.component_bins: fixed quintiles of each risk_<feature> using [0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1] on its already-calibrated risk percentile; no outcome-derived cuts
analysis.age_standardization: for each state/component, compute Q5-Q1 inside each frozen age bin and aggregate with that state/component Q1+Q5 age-support weights; also report a common pooled-age reweighting diagnostic
stability: known_index mod 8 cohort sign across all 8 cohorts
analysis.interaction_summary: for each component, report DOWN(Q5-Q1)-UP(Q5-Q1), with the same block bootstrap; no fitted feature selection
analysis.reference_score_summary: repeat the same state-specific Q5-Q1 decomposition for frozen equal-weight compression_score only as reference, not as a new model

COMPONENT_COHERENT_DIRECTION_ASYMMETRY.rule: CURRENT_DOWN has at least 3 of 4 components with age-standardized Q5-Q1 > 0, bootstrap CI lower > 0, and positive sign in at least 2 of 3 years; CURRENT_UP has at most 1 component meeting all three conditions; at least 2 component DOWN-minus-UP interaction CIs have lower > 0.

AGE_COMPOSITION_DOMINANT.rule: common-age reweighting reduces the frozen reference-score DOWN-minus-UP Q5-Q1 gap by at least 50%, and COMPONENT_COHERENT_DIRECTION_ASYMMETRY is false.

interpretation_boundaries: The labels above classify mechanism evidence on already-exposed development data; they are not new confirmatory scientific support.
No result can reclassify issue #624 as supported.
No result can authorize a CURRENT_DOWN-only trading rule or intervention.
No result can authorize a new cross-frequency context candidate.
A follow-up predictive model requires a separate preregistration and explicit stop rule.
stop_rule: Do not add new features, alternate age bins, alternate horizons, new thresholds, or other-frequency context inside issue #647. If the fixed audit is mixed/inconclusive, close the issue without feature-zoo expansion.
